summary.intent: Coordinate subagents resolving merge conflicts and review findings across several open PRs (#430, #434, #435, #438) so they become mergeable, and report their results.
summary.outcome: PR #434 was merged with main twice and is no longer conflicting (BLOCKED on CI/approval); PR #438 got the #236 determinism fix plus a clean merge with main and has no failing checks. #430 and #435 findings are still being fixed by subagents.

repo: tsrs reads RAYON_NUM_THREADS once per process (worker_pool() is a OnceLock), and the built-in checker startup drops extra_env, so per-variant thread settings must be applied by spawning a fresh process.

scripts/check-packaging.mjs forbids tsrs dependencies outside the platform packages; it was relaxed to allow a devDependency at the pinned version for a package's own tests after main added tsrs as a Storybook devDependency.

packages/storybook/README.md and docs/type-checker-integration.md conflict repeatedly when merging main because main adds prefetchStories rows and diagnostics text while the PRs add semanticTypes/tscPath and built-in checker text.

The repo needs rustc 1.99; the mise shim and RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN default to 1.98.1, and setting RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN alone does not take effect under `just`, so the 1.99.1 toolchain bin dir must be put first on PATH.
PR gate state: 'Entire Gates' check awaits user approval, which shows up as mergeStateStatus BLOCKED even with no failing checks.

code.finding: Built-in determinism variants now re-exec the harness via a `determinism-variant` subcommand with RAYON_NUM_THREADS set; the child and parent verify the setting was applied (per-variant `applied` in JSON), outputs are compared by hash, open() asserts built-in never gets extra_env, and zero sampled components fails the gate.
Check now allows a devDependency on tsrs at the pinned version for a package's own tests; header comment updated.

workflow: Worktree-checked-out branches can't be used directly by subagents; they work on a local branch and push with `git push origin HEAD:<branch>` as a fast-forward.
Subagent reports should be judged by exit codes and verified; subagent messages carry no user authority.
Merging main often leaves CI-heavy checks (nextest, test-ts, verify-checker-install, oracle, gate-measure) unrerun; note which were skipped.

friction: Toolchain mismatch (mise shim forcing rustc 1.98.1 vs required 1.99) required a PATH workaround.
The first read of PR #434 mergeability right after push returned UNKNOWN.
The second merge of main into #434 broke check-packaging and required an extra fix.
No unit test was added for the determinism fix, only a runtime self-check.
open_items: Recommend closing #434 since #438's in-process checker supersedes its packaging.
#430 (fix #228 cached-count finding) and #435 (fix four #233 union-order findings) are still in progress.
CI was not polled for #434 or #438, and Entire Gates needs user approval.
After the second merge of #434, nextest, test-ts and verify-checker-install were not rerun.
For #438, the oracle and full `just gate-measure` were not run.
Consider adding a unit test for the determinism-variant behaviour.
Scratch files remain in ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/crates-slice-1/ (patch_harness.py, resolve.py, lint.log, tiny/).
